announce_text: The Central Parliament of the Ehrman Steadfast Republics ruled in favor of SOL-FED intervention to quell a contention zone. Be advised that your area of operation may contain hostiles of Imladrisean, Volkronen and XX-121 backgrounds. Every confirmed kill or capture will be rewarded by the Ehrman Republic Military. Gear up and prepare to deploy, the weather forecast reports blizzards!
